messages:
leila: Heads-up — multiple new signups reported failing the quickstart. The README curl and Windows instructions are inconsistent and people paste the wrong quoting for cmd/PowerShell and get 400/401.

leila: README currently shows a multi-line curl with backslashes which GitHub soft-wraps. Windows users paste it into cmd and the %ENV% bits get lost.

omar: We've also got a parity problem: the JS quickstart still calls `client.chat.create()` in a few places. The shipped SDK uses `client.responses.create()` now, so newcomers hit TypeError and bounce.

sara: Suggested fixes: replace the backslash multiline with a one-line curl example, add a Windows cmd example (using %REDWOOD_API_KEY%), add PowerShell example (using $env:REDWOOD_API_KEY), and update all JS snippets to responses.create. Also add a short troubleshooting note: "If a pasted curl fails, try the one-liner or check your shell's variable syntax."

sara: Curl one-liner (cross-shell friendly):

```
curl -sS --header 'Content-Type: application/json' --header 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY' https://api.redwood.example/v1/responses --data-raw '{"input":"Hello from curl"}'
```

sara: Windows cmd variant (note %VAR%):

```
set REDWOOD_API_KEY=your_key_here
curl -sS --header "Content-Type: application/json" --header "Authorization: Bearer %REDWOOD_API_KEY%" https://api.redwood.example/v1/responses --data-raw "{"input":"Hello from cmd"}"
```

sara: PowerShell variant (uses $env:):

```powershell
$body = '{"input":"Hello from PowerShell"}'
Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'https://api.redwood.example/v1/responses' -Method Post -Headers @{ Authorization = "Bearer $env:REDWOOD_API_KEY"; 'Content-Type' = 'application/json' } -Body $body
```

omar: JS quickstart canonical update (replace old calls):

```js
import Redwood from '@redwoodai/sdk';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
const res = await client.responses.create({ input: 'Hello' });
console.log(res.output);
```

leila: I'll open a tiny PR updating the README with the one-liner, cmd/PowerShell snippets, and replacing old JS calls. Also adding a Troubleshooting note about shell variable syntax and fish users needing `$REDWOOD_API_KEY` wrapped in braces.

support-bot: Created issue #4987: "docs: quickstart - fix curl quoting for Windows/PowerShell, add one-liner, and update JS SDK calls to responses.create" — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/4987

docs-bot: Linked PR #5012 to issue #4987 and scheduled docs staging deploy.

leila: Thanks — will ping once PR is green for a reviewer.
